_note: Locked 2026-09-29 from Direction C, reference ../artwork/concepts/direction-3.jpg. Hex values were sampled from that render and are starting points for Blender materials; match the reference by eye. Changing any value needs the user's approval (log in docs/DECISIONS.md).

panel.material: anodized aluminium, fine bead-blasted matte texture
panel.finish: matte, very low specular, faint micro-grain
panel.sections: thin rounded-rectangle outlines (~1.5 px @1x, radius ~8 px) in the print colour; section title sits centred on the top edge, breaking the line

cheeks.material: light oak, straight grain, matte oiled finish, softly rounded edges

knob.body: solid machined aluminium, cylindrical, fine vertical knurling on the side
knob.cap: satin aluminium top with concentric brushed finish, slight dome
knob.indicator: black engraved line from centre to edge

button.cap: square, whole cap is backlit (no separate LED dot), thin dark bezel
button.on_glow: warm amber, soft bloom just past the cap edge
button.off: dark smoked cap, faint reflection, no glow

display.type: 3-digit red-orange 7-segment LED readout in a small dark recessed window, top centre

print.font: Kode Mono, UPPERCASE, letter-spacing ~0.05 em: section titles SemiBold ~16 px @1x, control labels Medium ~11 px @1x

lighting: soft studio key from the top left, gentle contact shadows under knobs and buttons
